description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: The project uses older versions of Jersey, Jackson, and other libraries that may carry known CVEs. Remediating these ensures a secure foundation for modernization.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Containerize the docraptor-java application and deploy it to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Moving to Azure Container Apps provides scalable, managed container hosting with Managed Identity support.
tasks.requirements: Create a Dockerfile for the Java application. Deploy to Azure Container Apps using Managed Identity for authentication. Use Bicep for infrastructure provisioning.
tasks.resourceStatus: Create new Azure Container Apps resource
